meta.title: Master source registry — all citations used across this project
meta.verification_method: Most inherited registry entries were checked by the sessions and dates recorded in each entry. This integration session opened AGLC, the NFL weekly injury page, the NFL roster page, the NFL injury-policy explainer, and cited NIST/Kaggle/NFL distribution references on 2026-11-12. Dynamic pages are cited with retrieval dates; the source type and verification scope are stated per entry.
meta.policy: Primary references are the NFL and its official properties, regulators, government/academic statistical sources, platform and operator documentation. Historical game/stat inputs are downloaded from the community-maintained nflverse repository, not directly published by the NFL; the source and verification limits are explicitly flagged. Third-party blogs are not used as primary sources; unconfirmed values are left blank and listed in data/flagged.json.
meta.integration_note: This registry combines multiple sessions. Per-source verified_by fields identify the session/date; the source list is not a claim that every historical data value was independently checked against an official NFL record.
